parts.text: A student investigates a pendulum. Fig. 1.1 and Fig. 1.2 show some of the apparatus used.

ms.label: 1(a)
ms.text: perpendicular viewing of scale / use of horizontal aid, e.g. set-square / clamp rule / rule close to pendulum

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The student displaces the bob slightly and releases it so that it swings. Fig. 1.2 shows one complete oscillation of the pendulum.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) He measures the time t for 20 complete oscillations. The time t is shown on the stopwatch in Fig. 1.3. In the first row of Table 1.1, record the time t shown in Fig. 1.3. [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate, and record in Table 1.1, the period T of the pendulum. The period is the time for one complete oscillation. [1]

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Calculate T 2 . Record its value in Table 1.1. [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The student repeats the procedure in (b) using d = 60.0 cm, 70.0 cm, 80.0 cm and 100.0 cm. The readings are shown in Table 1.1. Table 1.1 d / cm t / s T / s T 2 / s 2 50.0 60.0 30.00 1.50 2.25 70.0 33.20 1.66 2.76 80.0 35.80 1.79 3.20 100.0 39.80 1.99 3.96 Plot a graph of T 2 / s 2 ( y -axis) against d / cm ( x -axis). You do not need to start your axes at the origin (0,0). [4]

ms.label: 1(c)
ms.text:
graph:
axes correctly labelled and right way round
suitable scales
all plots correct to ½ small square
good line judgement, thin, continuous line

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Determine the gradient G of the line. Show clearly on the graph how you obtained the necessary information. G = ........................................................ [2]

ms.label: 1(d)
ms.text:
triangle method indicated on graph
with triangle at least half of candidate’s line between the extreme plotted points

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Calculate the acceleration of free fall g in m / s 2 using the equation g = 0.395 G , where G is your gradient from (d) . Write down the value of g to a suitable number of significant figures for this experiment. g = .................................................m / s 2 [2]

ms.label: 1(e)
ms.text:
correct calculation of g
to 2 or 3 significant figures
